name: Small Eco Awards
summary: Grants of £300 to £20,000 for community-led environmental projects in Scotland, Northern Ireland and Wales, such as helping people care for nature or improving the local environment. Open to applications.

steps: Country-specific online application, at least 12 weeks before funds needed

eligibility.rule: Have at least 2 directors who are not related
If the applicant is a company, reinvest profits for charitable purposes
Not have had funding for the same work
Apply directly, or together as a partnership, rather than on behalf of another organisation
Have a policy explaining how people will be kept safe
Make a school project clearly benefit the wider community
Make a school project go beyond the school's usual responsibilities
The project has not started or incurred costs before funding approval

documents: Bank statement from last 3 months, or welcome letter or transaction listing if the account is under 3 months old
Land/building: ownership proof, or 5+ year lease (or owner letter confirming it) plus permission to do the work

applicant_types.quote: constituted voluntary or community organisation constituted group or club registered charity charitable incorporated organisation (CIO) not-for-profit company community interest company (CIC) schools, if the project helps the local community, not just the school sports groups, if the project is open to the wider community statutory body

geography.quote: This funding is for projects based in one of the following countries: Northern Ireland Scotland Wales

access.quote: You can apply using our online form

window.quote: Submit your application at least 12 weeks before you need the funding.

effort.quote: You can apply using our online form
Submit your application at least 12 weeks before you need the funding.
we’ll review your application and respond within 12 weeks

eligibility.quote: You must have at least 2 directors who are not related.
companies that pay profits to directors, shareholders or members (rather than reinvesting them for charitable purposes).
organisations that have had funding for the same work
one organisation applying on behalf of another (unless you're applying together as a partnership)
You'll need to have a policy in place which explains how you'll keep people safe.
we can fund schools or organisations working with a school if your project clearly benefits the wider community.
Projects must go beyond the school's usual responsibilities.
You must wait for approval before starting your project or spending money.

documents.quote: recent bank statement (if your account was opened in the last 3 months provide a bank welcome letter or transaction listing instead)

If you need funding for land or building work, you must provide one of the following: proof of ownership of the land or building a lease for at least 5 years and proof of permission from the owner or landlord to do the work a letter from the owner confirming a lease for at least 5 years and proof of permission from the owner or landlord to do the work
